introduction: The engine_core spec creates internal/engine, a shared library of deterministic pipeline steps — the Run type, the Ledger (change tracker), the GateCache (verification cache), parking, branching, the aborted verdict, index invalidation, background context, push-with-retries and PR opening — so that codefix and codeimpl call one engine instead of maintaining two divergent copies of the same machine.

glossary.GateCache: A verification result cache keyed by (tree-hash, command) that prevents redundant verification runs.
glossary.Ledger: The engine's change tracker that records the pre-phase untracked snapshot, classifies changed paths, and produces the commit's file list. Replaces untrackedNow/commitOwn/leftAlone/unlisted/ownChange/dirtyAfterCommit in both packages.
glossary.gate: The project's verification commands (linter, all_tests) run before and after a change to classify the outcome.
glossary.parking: Committing the current work as a wip: commit with hooks skipped, under a cancellation-proof context, and returning the checkout to the base branch.
glossary.tree hash: A content-addressable key computed from git write-tree (or HEAD^{tree} when clean) combined with the sorted untracked files the ledger knows about.
glossary.work branch: The branch created by the engine for a run's changes (fix/* or impl/*).

requirements.title: Run type and NewRun constructor
requirements.rationale: A single shared state object lets both pipelines call engine functions without passing a dozen arguments to each.

criteria.action: hold the fields Root (string, symlink-resolved), Git (*gitx.Git), Lang (lang.Detection), Branch (BranchInfo), Ledger (*Ledger), Gate (*GateCache), Index (tools.Index, nil when absent), Scratch (string), Progress (toolio.Progress), and Record (*toolio.Run)

criteria.condition: NewRun is called with a root, git handle, options and lang.Detection
criteria.action: return a fully initialised *Run with a new Ledger and GateCache, or an error

criteria.condition: the root passed to NewRun is not a git repository
criteria.action: return a nil Run and a non-nil error describing the problem

requirements.title: Ledger: snapshot, commit and change classification
requirements.rationale: One Ledger replaces six divergent untracked-file functions across codefix and codeimpl, making commit logic consistent.

criteria.condition: Ledger.Snapshot is called
criteria.action: record the current untracked files as a map[string]bool; if git.UntrackedFiles errors, set the snapshot to nil (meaning unknown, commit everything)

criteria.condition: Ledger.Changes is called with a git handle and a since-ref
criteria.action: return a []Change where each entry carries Path, Status (A/M/D/?), and Kind classified as one of test, docs, implementation, gate-config, scratch, or protected, using lang.Detection.TestFile, project.IsDocsFile, the gate-config classifier, and path-prefix checks

criteria.condition: Ledger.Commit is called
criteria.action: commit everything except files in the snapshot (left-alone) and foreign-spec paths, warn with WarnUntrackedFilesLeftAlone for left-alone files and WarnUnlistedFileCommitted for new files the phase report did not list, and call git.CommitAllExcept

criteria.condition: Ledger.SetOwned is called with paths
criteria.action: mark those paths as run-owned so they are included in commits and not classified as foreign

criteria.condition: Ledger.SetProtected is called with paths and a phase changes one of them
criteria.action: classify those paths as protected in Changes and enable the caller to revert them with a warning

criteria.condition: Ledger.SetForeignPath is called with a predicate
criteria.action: use that predicate during Commit to treat matching untracked files as left-alone, replacing the hardcoded foreignSpecPath logic from codeimpl

criteria.condition: Ledger.OwnChange is called
criteria.action: return true when the tree has changes the run made (anything not in the snapshot), false otherwise

criteria.condition: Ledger.FlagGateEdits is called with a since-ref
criteria.action: detect gate-config edits, deleted test files, rewritten golden files and added skip markers using the classifiers moved from codeimpl/gateedits.go, and warn via the run recorder with WarnGateEdited

requirements.title: Gate cache
requirements.rationale: Caching verification results by tree hash prevents redundant runs that cost minutes per invocation.

criteria.condition: GateCache.Run is called and the (treeHash, command) key is in the cache
criteria.action: return the cached checks.Result without executing the command, and record a timing entry with cached: true

criteria.condition: GateCache.Run is called and the (treeHash, command) key is not in the cache
criteria.action: call checks.Run, store the result keyed by (treeHash, command), and return it
compute the tree hash as git rev-parse HEAD^{tree} when the tree is clean, and as git write-tree (after staging) when there are uncommitted changes

criteria.condition: GateCache.RunGate is called with multiple commands
criteria.action: run each command through the cache individually and return a GateResult containing all checks, matching the behaviour of codeimpl's runGate

criteria.condition: the tree hash computation fails
criteria.action: fall through to an uncached checks.Run call rather than returning an error
criteria.contract: checks.Result from the live run, no error returned to caller

criteria.action: export the GateResult type (moved from codeimpl/types.go) with its methods Ran, OK, couldNotRun, aborted, and failing, and export compareGate and landable (moved from codeimpl/gate.go)

requirements.title: Parking
requirements.rationale: A single Park function eliminates the divergence where codefix sometimes ran hooks on park commits and codeimpl always skipped them.

criteria.condition: engine.Park is called and the ledger reports own changes
criteria.action: create a background context via context.WithTimeout(context.WithoutCancel(ctx), 2*time.Minute), commit via Ledger.Commit with noVerify: true, check out the base branch, and return the commit hash
criteria.contract: (commit string, err error) where err is always nil; failures are warnings

criteria.condition: engine.Park is called and the ledger reports no own changes
criteria.action: skip the commit, check out the base branch, and return an empty commit hash

criteria.condition: the commit during Park fails
criteria.action: warn with WarnCommitNotParked and continue to the checkout step; never return an error that stops the pipeline
criteria.contract: WarnCommitNotParked warning emitted, nil error returned

criteria.condition: the checkout during Park or ReturnCheckout fails
criteria.action: warn with WarnCheckoutNotRestored and return without error
criteria.contract: WarnCheckoutNotRestored warning emitted, nil error returned

criteria.action: always pass noVerify: true to Ledger.Commit, so that git hooks are skipped on every wip: commit

requirements.title: Branching
requirements.rationale: One branching function prevents the divergence where codefix and codeimpl handle branch creation and detached-HEAD detection differently.

criteria.condition: engine.SetupBranch is called with a prefix, number and title
criteria.action: capture the base branch via git.BaseBranch, compute the work branch name via gitx.BranchName and gitx.UniqueBranchName, create the branch via git.CreateBranch, record base/work/merge-base on run.Branch, and invalidate the index

criteria.condition: the base branch is a detached HEAD (empty string from CurrentBranch)
criteria.action: return a non-nil error describing the refusal
criteria.contract: non-nil error with message mentioning detached HEAD

criteria.condition: the base branch matches fix/* or impl/* patterns
criteria.action: return a non-nil error refusing to branch from a work branch
criteria.contract: non-nil error with message naming the work-branch pattern

criteria.condition: engine.ResumeBranch is called with an existing branch name
criteria.action: check out the existing branch, handle parked-attempt detection and reset, and record the branch info on run.Branch

requirements.title: Aborted verdict in checks.Compare
requirements.rationale: Without an aborted verdict, a cancelled verification run is compared as if it failed, producing a false regression report.

criteria.condition: checks.Compare is called and either the baseline or the after Result has Aborted == true
criteria.action: return VerdictAborted ("aborted")
not be landable: VerdictAborted.Landable() returns false
export VerdictAborted as a const of type Verdict with value "aborted"

requirements.title: Background context, index invalidation and common preflight
requirements.rationale: These small shared utilities each exist as identical copies in both packages; consolidating them eliminates drift.

criteria.condition: engine.Background is called with a context
criteria.action: return context.WithTimeout(context.WithoutCancel(ctx), 2*time.Minute)

criteria.condition: engine.Invalidate is called and the run has a non-nil Index
criteria.action: call Index.Invalidate("")

criteria.condition: engine.Invalidate is called and the run has a nil Index
criteria.action: do nothing and not panic

criteria.condition: engine.CommonPreflight is called
criteria.action: check repository existence via git.IsRepo, clean working tree via git.DirtyFiles, base branch capture and validation (not detached, not a work branch), remote existence when pushing, and forge authentication when opening PRs, returning a non-nil error on the first failure
criteria.contract: nil error when all checks pass, non-nil error on first failure

requirements.title: Push with retries and pull request opening
requirements.rationale: Consolidating push and PR logic ensures body truncation and retry behaviour are consistent across both tools.

criteria.condition: engine.Push is called
criteria.action: call git.Push with the given number of attempts, report progress, and record the side effect
criteria.contract: nil error on success, non-nil error on failure after all attempts

criteria.condition: engine.OpenPullRequest is called
criteria.action: truncate the PR body to issuex.MaxBodyLength(forge) before sending, open the PR via forge.CreatePullRequest, and return the PR URL

criteria.condition: the PR body exceeds the forge's MaxBodyLength
criteria.action: truncate the body to fit within the limit before sending, so the forge never rejects the request for body size
criteria.contract: the body sent to CreatePullRequest has len <= MaxBodyLength

requirements.title: Migration: both pipelines call the engine
requirements.rationale: The engine is only useful if both tools actually use it; the migration replaces duplicated functions with engine calls.

criteria.action: hold a *engine.Run field for shared state, and delegate untracked-file tracking, commit, parking, branching, background context and index invalidation to engine functions
hold a *engine.Run field for shared state, and delegate untracked-file tracking, commit, parking, branching, background context and index invalidation to engine functions
not change any flag, exit code, envelope field or schema version; the --schema golden files remain unchanged

remove the package-local background, parkWork, commitOwn/commitOwnHooks, untrackedNow, noteUntracked, leftAlone, foreignSpecPath, commit, unlisted, dirtyAfterCommit, ownChange, invalidate, and returnCheckout functions from codefix and codeimpl once the engine equivalents are wired

requirements.title: Gate-edit classifiers move to the engine
requirements.rationale: The testFile, gateConfigFile, goldenFile and skipMarker classifiers are needed by the Ledger's change classification and gate-edit detection.

criteria.action: export the gateConfigFile classifier that identifies build/lint configuration files, using lang.Profile.GateConfig when available and falling back to the current hardcoded list for files not covered by any profile
delegate test-file classification to lang.Detection.TestFile instead of hardcoding language-specific suffixes
export the goldenFile classifier and skipMarker regex, moved from codeimpl/gateedits.go without behavioural change

execution_paths.title: A codefix run branches, implements, parks and returns to base via the engine

steps.action: invokes codefix with a bug report
calls engine.NewRun to create the shared Run with Ledger and GateCache
calls engine.CommonPreflight to validate the repository, clean tree, base branch and credentials
calls engine.SetupBranch to capture the base, create the work branch, record merge-base and invalidate the index
calls Ledger.Snapshot before the implementation phase
runs the model's implementation phase, which modifies files in the tree
calls Ledger.Commit to commit the changes, leaving snapshot files in the tree
calls GateCache.Run to verify the change, receiving a cached or live checks.Result
calls engine.Park when the run is interrupted, which commits under a cancellation-proof context with hooks skipped and checks out the base branch
returns the commit hash and emits no error; any failure is a warning

execution_paths.title: A codeimpl run uses the engine's gate cache and gets a cache hit on the second task

steps.action: invokes codeimpl with a spec package
calls engine.NewRun and engine.CommonPreflight
calls GateCache.RunGate for the baseline with multiple commands
computes the tree hash, finds no cache entry, runs checks.Run for each command, stores results
implements task 1, commits via Ledger.Commit, and calls GateCache.RunGate for verification
computes the new tree hash, finds no cache entry, runs checks.Run, stores results
reverts task 1 for a revert check, restoring the tree to the pre-task state
computes the tree hash, finds a cache hit from the baseline, returns the cached result with cached: true in timings

execution_paths.title: A cancelled verification run produces the aborted verdict and the pipeline parks without comparing

steps.action: invokes codefix and cancels the run (Ctrl-C) during the verification phase
detects context cancellation and returns a Result with Aborted == true
receives a Result with Aborted == true and returns VerdictAborted
observes VerdictAborted, skips the comparison, and calls engine.Park
creates a background context, commits with hooks skipped, checks out the base branch, and returns the commit hash

execution_paths.title: SetupBranch refuses a detached HEAD in preflight

steps.action: invokes codefix on a repository in detached HEAD state
calls engine.SetupBranch
calls git.BaseBranch which returns an empty string, and returns a non-nil error refusing the detached HEAD
maps the error to a preflight failure and reports it to the operator
